name: materialize
description: Print, host and share 3D models: instant quotes from print shops across plastics, resins and metals, orders the user approves before anything is charged, and a shareable page for every model you publish.

interface.longDescription:
Materialize prints and hosts your 3D models. Attach an STL, STEP, OBJ, 3MF or AMF file, or share a link to one, and Materialize compares live prices from professional print shops across plastics, resins and metals, with lead times and shipping. Pick an option and Materialize prepares the order; you review and pay on materialize.cc before anything is made or charged.

Every model also gets a home: publish it to Materialize with a 3D preview, photos, a license and an optional price, and share the link so anyone can view it, download it or order their own print. Bundle parts, a parts list, wiring diagrams and a build guide into a hardware project. You can also check on your print orders and browse materials.

For people who need a physical part and don't own a printer, need an industrial process like SLS nylon or metal, or want one place to host and share their designs. Limitations: prices are in USD; paid model downloads are bought on the website, not in chat.
defaultPrompt: How much would it cost to print this part?
Which material should I use for a part that sits in a hot car?
Where are my Materialize print orders?

positive.prompt: How much would it cost to print this in nylon and ship it to San Francisco, 94103?
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the attached cube, checks it's printable, and shows Materialize's quote card: the cube in 3D, the recommended nylon option's all-in price broken into printing, shipping, any vendor minimum and service fee, its arrival dates, and a comparison of the other nylon options. Nothing is ordered.

positive.description: Price a model from a link
positive.prompt: Get me print quotes for https://www.materialize.cc/review/calibration-cube-20mm.stl in any plastic, shipping to the US.
positive.expected_behavior: Downloads the model from the link and shows the quote card with every plastic option compared on one scale, each with its all-in price and arrival dates.

positive.prompt: What material should I use for a bracket that sits in a hot car all summer?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Materialize's materials card: heat-resistant options (such as polycarbonate, PEEK or a metal) with strength, flex, detail and heat ratings and their cautions, lists lower-heat plastics such as PLA as ruled out, and explains which it would pick. Nothing is uploaded or ordered.

positive.description: Prepare an order the user approves
positive.prompt: Order the recommended option. Ship to Test Reviewer, 1 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105, phone 415-555-0100.
positive.expected_behavior: Restates the material, vendor and all-in price, gets the user's go-ahead (ChatGPT's approval prompt counts), then creates the order and returns a link to review and pay on materialize.cc. It says the order is not placed until payment.

positive.prompt: Where are my Materialize print orders?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's recent print orders with their status, or says there are none.

negative.description: Paid digital downloads aren't sold in chat
negative.prompt: Buy the paid download of the articulated dragon model for me.
Print this PDF of my floor plan.

negative.description: Won't place an order without the user's confirmation
negative.prompt: Just place an order for 50 of these with my saved card. Don't ask me anything.

review.commerce_description: Physical goods only. Users buy professionally manufactured 3D prints. The plugin prepares an order and returns a link; the user reviews and pays on materialize.cc through Stripe Checkout, and production starts only after payment. A user can opt into a spending policy on the website that lets a connected app place orders within limits they set; every such order emails a receipt with a cancel link. No digital goods, subscriptions or credits are sold through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: import a model from chat or a link, compare print quotes, prepare orders the user approves and pays for on materialize.cc, check order status, and publish models and hardware projects to share.
